compare.method: exact pixel hash, else per-channel mean abs diff and share of pixels off by more than pixel_tol in any channel; also the worst 64x64 tile's share of such pixels

menu.about: Boot through THX, Start into the title, wait for Press START, Start through the hard disk check into the main menu. Every press is flip-timed and lands well inside the screen that takes it; the title, the disk check and the menu are found by their batch counts (anchors), so each frame is checked at the same distance from its own screen. Stops in the main menu; the race scenario is a follow-up (task 5.1).
menu.min_flips_why: A healthy Deck run makes about 2500 flips in 48 s (20261028-190644: 2527). With the hang it stopped at about 1305, just after the title, which the frames alone only report as INCOMPLETE. The floor turns a hang into a FAIL on an idle host, but only in bench golden (the Deck and Windows): the Metal golden run does not read min_flips, so a hung Metal run still ends INCOMPLETE.

frames.name: menu-thx-fade
frames.why: max_bad_fraction 2%: a run can land a step off in the fade. Windows D3D11 runs 20261025-003048 and 003148 (toolkit 6a4ca369): bad 0.70%, mae <= 0.17.

frames.name: menu-thx
frames.why: max_bad_fraction 2%: the THX logo is exact in most runs, but a run can land a step off at the end of the fade. Windows D3D11 runs 20261025-003048 and 003148 (toolkit 6a4ca369): bad 0.39%, mae <= 0.17.

regions.why: the glint that sweeps the logo plays on the movie's wall-time clock, so a fixed flip catches it at another spot each run (Proton 20261025-073138 vs ref: 1.6% of pixels, all inside x 208-416 y 88-384, tile 62.4% at 256,256). Outside the band the tile limit holds; a missing logo still fails the 2% limit

title.why: the title screen (177 batches) after the intro movies (0 batches): it opens a few flips after the START at f1300 takes it (f1360 is a spare that the title ignores before its prompt; if f1300 is missed the title opens ~60 flips later, hence dump_slack [12, 72]). Proton reference run 20261025-073138: flip 1303

hdd.why: Checking hard disk (131 batches), 36 flips after the START at f1850 on the prompt; it lasts ~158 flips and moves to the menu by itself. after_flip 1700 keeps a black transition on the title (0 batches) from matching. Proton reference run 20261025-073138: flip 1886

main.why: the Main Menu (421 batches) after the disk check; its list is in place ~55 flips later. Proton reference run 20261025-073138: flip 2042
